question: An enterprise company uses AWS Organizations to manage a multi-account environment. The security team requires that account administrators in member accounts are prevented from turning off AWS CloudTrail logging, deleting AWS Config rules, or detaching security guardrail IAM policies from roles. The solution must ensure that local account administrators, including root users, cannot bypass these restrictions. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Attach an IAM permissions boundary to all IAM roles in every member account that explicitly denies cloudtrail:StopLogging, config:DeleteConfigRule, and iam:DetachRolePolicy.
Apply a Service Control Policy (SCP) at the Organization root or Organizational Unit (OU) level that explicitly denies cloudtrail:StopLogging, config:DeleteConfigRule, and iam:DetachRolePolicy.
Deploy AWS Config rules in all member accounts to detect unauthorized policy detachments and automatically re-attach policies using an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook.
Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy local IAM admin groups in each member account with an explicit DENY for CloudTrail, AWS Config, and IAM policy modification actions.

question: A company stores reporting files in an Amazon S3 bucket in Account A. The files are encrypted at rest using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) Customer Managed Key (CMK). Analytics application servers running in Account B must be granted permissions to download and decrypt these S3 objects. Which combination of permission configurations is required to grant cross-account access?
options: Update the S3 bucket policy in Account A to allow Account B access, and attach an IAM policy to the role in Account B allowing kms:Decrypt on the KMS key ARN.
Update the AWS-managed KMS key policy in Account A to allow Account B, and attach an S3 read policy to the role in Account B.

Update the S3 bucket policy in Account A and the KMS key policy in Account A to grant access to Account B, AND attach an IAM policy to the role in Account B granting s3:GetObject and kms:Decrypt permissions.
Use AWS STS in Account A to issue cross-account root credentials directly to the EC2 instances in Account B.

question: A company operates a public-facing e-commerce application behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). During peak promotional events, the web application experiences HTTP flood attacks (Layer 7 DDoS) and malicious SQL injection attempts aimed at compromising the database. A solutions architect must implement a solution that automatically inspects web requests, blocks known web application exploits, and limits request rates per client IP address. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST management overhead?
options: Associate AWS WAF with the Application Load Balancer, and configure AWS Managed Rules for SQL database protection along with a rate-based rule statement.
Enable AWS Shield Advanced on the Application Load Balancer and write custom Lambda@Edge code to inspect incoming POST body parameters.
Deploy Amazon GuardDuty and configure an automated Systems Manager Automation document to block attacking IP addresses in the subnet Network ACL.
Configure security group rules on the Application Load Balancer to drop incoming HTTP connections that exceed 100 requests per minute.

question: An enterprise application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in a VPC. The security team needs an automated detection and response system to identify compromised EC2 instances communicating with known malicious command-and-control IP addresses and immediately isolate the compromised instances from the network. Which combination of AWS services and actions will meet these requirements with the LEAST latency? (Select TWO.)
options: Configure AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to perform hourly scans on all EC2 instances for malware.
Enable Amazon GuardDuty to continuously monitor VPC Flow Logs and DNS logs for unauthorized or malicious activity.
Create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs metric filter that scans EC2 operating system syslog files every 24 hours.
Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that triggers an AWS Lambda function upon receiving GuardDuty findings to replace the instance's Security Group with an isolated quarantine Security Group.
Configure an AWS Config rule that triggers an AWS Systems Manager Automation document to terminate the EC2 instance immediately.

question: An organization must securely store sensitive database credentials used by an application running on Amazon EC2 instances. The credentials must be encrypted at rest, automatically rotated every 30 days without application downtime, and access must be audited via AWS CloudTrail. Which AWS service should be used to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Store the credentials in an Amazon S3 bucket with Server-Side Encryption with AWS KMS (SSE-KMS) and invoke an AWS Lambda function daily via Amazon EventBridge to update credentials.
Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager and enable automatic rotation using a built-in AWS Lambda template.
Store the credentials as encrypted SecureString parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and write a custom application script on EC2 to rotate keys.
Encrypt credentials using an AWS KMS Customer Managed Key (CMK) and embed the encrypted ciphertext directly in the application configuration code.

question: A company is deploying a two-tier web application on AWS. The web servers are located in a public subnet, and the database servers are in a private subnet. The solutions architect must ensure that the database instances accept incoming traffic ONLY on TCP port 5432 from the web servers and block all other incoming connections. Which configuration meets this requirement at the instance level with stateful traffic filtering?
options: Configure a Security Group for the database instances that permits inbound TCP port 5432 with the web servers' Security Group ID as the source.
Configure a Network ACL for the database subnet with an inbound ALLOW rule on TCP port 5432 from the public subnet CIDR and an outbound DENY rule.
Configure an AWS WAF Web ACL attached to the private subnet to inspect traffic targeting TCP port 5432.
Configure an Application Load Balancer in the private subnet with an HTTP listener on port 5432 pointing to the database instances.

question: A fleet of Amazon EC2 instances running in private subnets processes large batches of data daily and uploads the output to Amazon S3. The current architecture routes traffic through NAT Gateways, resulting in high monthly data transfer charges. A solutions architect must modify the network design to enable private connectivity to S3 and eliminate NAT Gateway data processing charges for S3 traffic without exposing instances to the public internet. Which solution achieves this goal with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Create a Gateway Endpoint Service in AWS PrivateLink and attach it to the EC2 instances' Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs).
Create a Gateway VPC Endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC, and attach it to the route tables of the private subnets.
Deploy an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the private subnets and Amazon S3 public endpoints.
Configure an Interface VPC Endpoint for Amazon S3 in each private subnet, and set up a custom BGP route.

question: A Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) vendor hosts a centralized data processing service in a provider VPC. Multiple corporate customers need to connect their client VPCs to the SaaS provider service. Some customer VPCs have overlapping IPv4 CIDR blocks with the provider VPC. The connection must be secure, strictly unidirectionally initiated from the customer VPCs, and must not route over the public internet. Which architecture satisfies these requirements?
options: Establish VPC Peering connections between each customer VPC and the provider VPC, and configure policy-based routing tables.
Create an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service in the provider VPC backed by a Network Load Balancer (NLB), and instruct customers to create Interface VPC Endpoints in their VPCs.
Deploy an AWS Transit Gateway in the provider account and create VPC attachments to all customer VPCs across AWS accounts.
Set up an AWS Site-to-Site VPN between each customer VPC and an Internet Gateway attached to the provider VPC.

question: A mobile fitness application allows users to authenticate using external social identity providers (Google and Apple) and directly upload workout video recordings to user-specific folders in an Amazon S3 bucket. The application must grant authenticated users temporary, least-privilege access credentials to upload files directly to S3 without passing credentials through application backend servers. Which AWS solution should be used?
options: Create an IAM user for each registered mobile user, and generate permanent IAM access keys upon user login.
Use an Amazon Cognito User Pool to authenticate users, and configure Amazon Cognito Identity Pools (Federated Identities) to exchange identity tokens for temporary AWS IAM credentials.
Store an AWS KMS Customer Managed Key in the mobile app bundle and encrypt video files before uploading via a public API Gateway endpoint.
Store a shared IAM role's secret access key in the mobile client application binary to call S3 PutObject directly.

question: A healthcare provider must comply with strict data sovereignty mandates requiring that no AWS infrastructure resources (e.g., EC2, RDS, S3) can be provisioned outside the us-east-1 and us-west-2 regions across all current and future accounts in the company's AWS Organization. The enforcement must be absolute, preventive, and operationalized automatically whenever new AWS accounts are joined to the Organization. Which solution fulfills this requirement with the LEAST administrative overhead?
options: Apply an AWS Organizations Service Control Policy (SCP) at the Organization root that denies all requests (*) with a condition restricting aws:RequestedRegion to NOT equal us-east-1 or us-west-2 (excluding exempt global services).
Deploy an AWS CloudFormation StackSet that provisions IAM policies denying non-us regions in every member account.
Configure AWS Config rules in each account to monitor resource creation events and automatically trigger Lambda functions to delete non-compliant resources.
Use AWS Trusted Advisor regional checks to send daily email reports to the security team highlighting non-compliant regions.

question: A bank hosts a sensitive data application on EC2 instances running inside a specific VPC (vpc-12345678). The application accesses an Amazon S3 bucket containing confidential customer records. A security policy requires that S3 bucket requests must be permitted ONLY when originating from within vpc-12345678 via a VPC Endpoint (vpce-87654321). All requests originating from outside this VPC Endpoint, including public internet IPs or other VPCs, must be explicitly denied. Which S3 bucket policy configuration satisfies these security requirements?
options: Add a bucket policy with an Effect: Allow statement specifying Principal: '*' and Condition: {'StringEquals': {'aws:SourceVpc': 'vpc-12345678'}}.
Add a bucket policy with an Effect: Deny statement specifying Principal: '*' and Condition: {'StringNotEquals': {'aws:SourceIp': '10.0.0.0/16'}}.
Add a bucket policy with an Effect: Deny statement specifying Principal: '*' and Condition: {'StringNotEquals': {'aws:sourceVpce': 'vpce-87654321'}}.
Attach a Network ACL to the S3 bucket endpoint allowing inbound traffic only from vpce-87654321.

question: A global enterprise is deploying a low-latency relational database application across us-east-1 and eu-west-1. The application uses client-side encryption to encrypt sensitive payload attributes before storing them in the database. The application instances in both regions must be able to encrypt and decrypt the payload attributes locally using an AWS KMS key without making cross-region network calls to KMS endpoints in the other region. Which combination of KMS configurations supports this requirement? (Select TWO.)
options: Create an AWS KMS single-Region Customer Managed Key in us-east-1 and grant cross-region access permissions to IAM roles in eu-west-1.
Create an AWS KMS Multi-Region primary key in us-east-1 and replicate it to eu-west-1 as a Multi-Region replica key.
Configure AWS Secrets Manager to automatically synchronize KMS key material across regions every 24 hours.
Use the Multi-Region key in both regions so that data encrypted in us-east-1 can be decrypted locally by application instances in eu-west-1.
Export the plaintext private RSA key material from KMS and store it in an S3 bucket replicated across both regions.

question: A multinational enterprise uses AWS Organizations with 50 member accounts. A regulatory compliance framework mandates that all management events and required S3 object data events across all accounts must be logged centrally into a single dedicated security AWS account. The log files must be encrypted, locked against modification or deletion for a 7-year retention period, and protected against unauthorized tampering even by root administrators. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect perform? (Select THREE.)
options: Configure an Organization Trail in the AWS Organizations management account, designating a centralized Amazon S3 bucket located in the security account as the logging destination for management events.
Configure advanced event selectors on the Organization Trail to log S3 data events for required object buckets across member accounts.
Enable S3 Object Lock on the destination S3 bucket in Compliance mode, and set a default retention period of 7 years.
Create individual AWS CloudTrail trails in each member account pointing to a local S3 bucket in each account.
Configure S3 Lifecycle rules to transition CloudTrail logs to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 30 days without enabling Object Lock.
Store CloudTrail logs in an AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store SecureString parameter across member accounts.

question: A fintech application handles mission-critical payment processing on AWS. The infrastructure team must implement a continuous threat protection solution that offers 24/7 access to the AWS Shield Response Team (SRT), automatic Layer 7 DDoS mitigation on CloudFront and Application Load Balancers, and financial protection against scaling cost spikes caused by volumetric DDoS attacks. Which AWS service meets these exact operational and business requirements?
options: AWS Shield Standard
AWS Shield Advanced
AWS WAF Managed Rules
Amazon GuardDuty

question: An enterprise company contracts a third-party security auditing firm to perform read-only compliance assessments on S3 buckets in Account A. The auditing firm uses an automated tool hosted in their own AWS account (Account B). The solution must adhere to the principle of least privilege, prevent confused deputy attacks, and ensure the third-party auditors cannot escalate permissions inside Account A. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take? (Select TWO.)
options: Create an IAM role in Account A with a trust policy that permits Account B's principal and mandates an sts:ExternalId condition check.
Attach an IAM permission policy to the role in Account A granting s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket permissions restricted strictly to the target bucket ARNs.
Generate permanent IAM access keys in Account A and send them securely to the auditing firm via encrypted email.
Configure an AWS Organizations SCP in Account B granting cross-account admin access to Account A.
Enable AWS Inspector to perform automatic cross-account IAM role creation in Account B.

question: A solutions architect is designing the database tier for a critical enterprise application on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The application requires high availability and automatic failover in the event of an Availability Zone outage or primary database instance failure. Which deployment configuration satisfies these availability requirements with NO manual intervention required during failover?
options: Deploy the RDS PostgreSQL instance in a Single-AZ setup and configure hourly automated snapshots to Amazon S3.
Deploy the RDS PostgreSQL instance in a Multi-AZ deployment across two Availability Zones with synchronous physical replication.
Deploy a primary RDS PostgreSQL instance in one AZ and create an asynchronous Read Replica in another AZ.
Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance running PostgreSQL in a private subnet and attach an EBS gp3 volume.

question: An e-commerce order processing microservice receives transaction messages from a web front end. To prevent order corruption, message processing must occur strictly in the exact first-in, first-out (FIFO) sequence in which transactions were submitted by customers. Additionally, duplicate order messages must be prevented, and unparseable messages must be isolated after 3 failed delivery attempts without stalling the queue. Which AWS queue configuration fulfills these requirements?
options: Use an Amazon SQS Standard queue and configure a CloudWatch Alarm to invoke Lambda on poison messages.
Use an Amazon SQS FIFO queue with content-based deduplication enabled, and configure a Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) with maxReceiveCount set to 3.
Use an Amazon SNS Standard topic paired with an Amazon Kinesis Data Stream using partition keys.
Use an Amazon EventBridge Event Bus with a custom rule routing failed events to an S3 bucket.

question: A logistics enterprise is decoupling its core microservices backend. When a shipping package changes status, an order management event is published. Multiple independent downstream systems (Inventory, Billing, Customer Notifications, Data Warehouse) must receive this status change event simultaneously. If one downstream system experiences an outage, it must not impact event delivery to the other systems. Which architectural pattern provides the MOST resilient, loosely coupled fan-out design?
options: Publish status change events directly to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) topic that fans out messages to individual Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) queues dedicated to each downstream service.
Configure the web front end to send synchronous HTTPS POST API requests directly to each downstream microservice sequentially.
Store status changes in an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster, and configure downstream services to poll Redis memory every second.
Write order events to a single shared Amazon EBS volume mounted across all downstream EC2 worker nodes using Multi-Attach.

question: A media company hosts a news portal using an Amazon CloudFront distribution paired with an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and EC2 instances as the primary origin for dynamic application traffic. During high-traffic breaking news events, backend server overload causes occasional HTTP 502 (Bad Gateway) and 504 (Gateway Timeout) errors. The company wants to ensure that when the ALB fails or returns 5xx errors on read-only HTTP GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS requests, end users receive a friendly static fallback web page from an Amazon S3 bucket instead of an unhandled error screen. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet this requirement? (Select TWO.)
options: Configure an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy that automatically redirects traffic from the ALB to the static S3 web hosting endpoint when health checks fail.
Create a CloudFront Origin Group containing the Application Load Balancer as the primary origin and the static fallback Amazon S3 bucket as the secondary origin.
Configure the CloudFront Origin Group failover criteria to trigger on 502, 503, and 504 HTTP status codes for eligible read requests.
Use AWS Lambda@Edge on viewer response events to rewrite all HTTP 5xx responses from the ALB into HTTP 200 OK responses containing static HTML body content.
Configure the CloudFront distribution's default cache behavior to automatically convert all incoming HTTP POST requests to HTTP GET requests during origin downtime.

question: A global company operates an active-passive disaster recovery architecture across two AWS Regions (us-east-1 primary and us-west-2 secondary). During a regional disaster, the company needs a highly reliable traffic failover control that does not depend on control plane API availability in the impaired primary Region. Which solution meets these requirements?
options: Configure Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) routing controls with Route 53 health checks that change DNS responses according to the routing control states.
Write a Python script hosted on an EC2 instance in us-east-1 that updates Route 53 A records using the Route 53 control plane API upon detecting failure.
Configure an AWS Lambda function in us-east-1 triggered by CloudWatch Alarms to modify the Application Load Balancer target group attachments.
Deploy an AWS Transit Gateway cross-region peering connection and manage failover manually via the AWS Management Console.

question: A financial application processes loan requests involving multiple microservices: credit scoring, background checks, income verification, and notification. The workflow contains long-running asynchronous steps that can take several hours. If a step fails, compensating actions must run automatically to reverse prior business operations. The orchestrator must maintain a durable execution history for auditing and troubleshooting. Which AWS service should be used?
options: AWS Step Functions Standard Workflows
AWS Step Functions Express Workflows
Amazon EventBridge custom event bus with Amazon SQS
AWS Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA)

question: A company requires a highly available and resilient hybrid network connection between its on-premises data center and an AWS VPC topology. The architecture must provide a dedicated, low-latency primary connection with high bandwidth, and an automated, cost-effective backup path over the public Internet. If the primary connection fails, traffic must automatically fail over to the backup path using BGP dynamic routing preferences. Which solution meets these requirements?
options: Establish two AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections over separate Internet service providers connected to a Virtual Private Gateway (VGW).
Deploy an AWS Direct Connect connection with a Public VIF as the primary path, and a second Direct Connect connection as the backup path.

Establish an AWS Direct Connect connection with a Transit VIF to a Direct Connect gateway associated with an AWS Transit Gateway as the primary path, and configure an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection to the Transit Gateway using BGP dynamic routing preference as the backup path.
Configure an AWS Transit Gateway with ECMP enabled across two AWS Direct Connect dedicated circuits.

question: A corporate enterprise needs a cross-region disaster recovery (DR) solution for a tier-2 business application. The current application consists of an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer and an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. The business leadership requires an RTO of less than 15 minutes and an RPO of less than 5 minutes while MINIMIZING idle infrastructure costs in the secondary region. Which disaster recovery strategy should be recommended?
options: Warm Standby: Maintain a scaled-down, functional environment in the secondary region with an active cross-region RDS Read Replica, and scale out EC2 capacity upon failover.

Pilot Light: Maintain data replication to a secondary region RDS Read Replica, but keep the web tier EC2 AMI and infrastructure defined as CloudFormation code without running active EC2 instances until failover.
Multi-Site Active-Active: Run full-capacity compute and database resources simultaneously in both primary and secondary regions with Route 53 latency routing.
Backup and Restore: Take daily snapshots of the database and EC2 instances, copy them to the secondary region, and rebuild the stack upon disaster declaration.

question: A company operates an online gaming application backed by an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database in us-east-1. To meet business continuity goals, the company requires a disaster recovery strategy with cross-Region replication providing very low replication latency (typically under 1 second) and rapid cross-Region recovery. During a Regional outage in us-east-1, the secondary Region (us-west-2) must be promoted to take full read-write traffic. Which combination of actions fulfills these requirements? (Select TWO.)
options: Create an Amazon Aurora Global Database with the primary cluster in us-east-1 and a secondary read-only cluster in us-west-2.
Use AWS DMS ongoing replication from the Aurora cluster in us-east-1 to a separately managed Aurora PostgreSQL cluster in us-west-2.
Perform a managed failover during a Regional outage to promote the secondary cluster in us-west-2 to primary read-write status.
Deploy an Aurora Multi-AZ DB cluster across three Availability Zones in us-east-1 and use automatic failover between DB instances.
Configure automated cross-Region Aurora database snapshots copied every 1 hour from us-east-1 to us-west-2.

question: An enterprise company must protect its Amazon EBS snapshots, Amazon RDS backups, and DynamoDB backups against ransomware attacks and unauthorized deletion by malicious internal actors. Security policy requires that once backups are taken, no IAM user, account administrator, or AWS account root user can delete or shorten the retention period of any backup for 365 days. Which AWS solution satisfies these stringent compliance and security requirements?
options: Configure AWS Backup and copy backups to a separate AWS account's Backup Vault secured with an AWS Backup Vault Lock configured in Compliance mode.
Store backups in an S3 bucket with versioning enabled and apply an IAM policy denying s3:DeleteObject to all non-root users.
Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in Governance mode across all member accounts.
Encrypt all EBS and RDS backups using AWS-managed KMS keys (aws/ebs and aws/rds).

question: A global online retailer runs regional application stacks behind Application Load Balancers in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. The public DNS name is an Amazon Route 53 alias to a CloudFront distribution. The company requires edge-level failover between the regional ALB origins for eligible read requests, and the application database must support active-active reads and writes in both Regions with sub-second replication. Which TWO configurations meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)
options: Configure the CloudFront distribution with an origin group containing the regional Application Load Balancers and define failover criteria for eligible GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS requests.
Use Amazon DynamoDB Global Tables to provide active-active multi-Region reads and writes with managed cross-Region replication.
Configure Route 53 latency-based records that point directly to both regional Application Load Balancers while using the same hostname as the CloudFront distribution.
Use Amazon RDS for MySQL cross-Region read replicas as active-active multi-master writers.
Use AWS Transit Gateway inter-Region peering to route public internet viewer requests to the nearest Application Load Balancer.
Use AWS Storage Gateway to replicate EC2 instance store volumes between the two Regions.

question: A media broadcaster uploads high-resolution video assets to an Amazon S3 bucket in us-east-1. To support European operations and disaster recovery requirements, eligible new objects must be replicated to a bucket in eu-west-1 by using an S3 replication feature backed by a 15-minute SLA. The company also needs replication metrics and notifications when replication exceeds the threshold. Which solution meets the requirements?
options: Configure S3 Same-Region Replication (SRR) and create a Lambda function to monitor bucket size.
Set up an AWS DataSync task scheduled to run every 15 minutes between the primary and secondary S3 buckets.
Configure Amazon S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) and enable S3 Replication Time Control (S3 RTC) on the replication rule.
Use Amazon EventBridge to trigger an AWS Batch job whenever an object is uploaded to copy objects using the AWS CLI.

question: An application deployed across three Availability Zones behind a Multi-AZ Application Load Balancer experiences intermittent performance degradation when a single Availability Zone (az1) undergoes underlying network degradation. Automatic ALB health checks are not failing fast enough because some requests still succeed. The architecture team needs an automated capability to temporarily shift application traffic away from the impaired Availability Zone without changing DNS records manually. Which solution fulfills this requirement?
options: Enable Route 53 Application Recovery Controller zonal autoshift for the Application Load Balancer.
Update the Auto Scaling group to set az1 capacity to 0 using the AWS CLI.
Configure AWS WAF on the ALB to block all client IP addresses originating from az1.
Attach a Network ACL to az1 subnets with an explicit DENY rule for all inbound traffic.

question: A gaming platform hosts a real-time multiplayer backend in two AWS Regions. Client applications establish persistent TCP connections directly to regional Network Load Balancers (NLBs) that have security groups configured. The gaming servers behind the NLBs rely on client source IP addresses for session validation and geo-filtering. Players report high connection latency and packet loss caused by public internet routing fluctuations during cross-region matchmaking. A solutions architect must improve connection routing performance and maintain consistent latency while ensuring that client IP preservation remains functional with the NLB security group setup. Which solution meets these requirements?
options: Deploy Amazon CloudFront in front of the regional Network Load Balancers, enabling client IP preservation in custom HTTP headers.
Deploy AWS Global Accelerator with static Anycast IP addresses, pointing to the regional Network Load Balancers as endpoint targets with client IP preservation enabled.
Configure Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing with a 5-second TTL to resolve DNS queries directly to the regional Network Load Balancer public IP addresses.
Deploy Amazon API Gateway regional TCP endpoints with AWS WAF enabled to proxy incoming player connections across VPC Peering connections.

question: A high-traffic e-commerce database on Amazon RDS for MySQL is experiencing CPU utilization spikes above 90% caused by repetitive read queries for popular product catalog items. A solutions architect must improve read performance and reduce database CPU load with minimal application latency. Which AWS caching component should be added to the architecture?
options: Amazon EBS Snapshot caching tier
Amazon ElastiCache for Redis in front of the RDS database
Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval bucket
AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway

question: An enterprise resource planning (ERP) application running on a Nitro-based Amazon EC2 instance requires a block storage volume that guarantees high I/O performance and consistent low latency. The workload demands 32,000 IOPS and 500 MB/s throughput continuously. The storage volume capacity requirement is 1 TiB. Which Amazon EBS volume type meets these performance requirements?
options: EBS General Purpose SSD (gp3)
EBS Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2)
EBS General Purpose SSD (gp2)
EBS Throughput Optimized HDD (st1)

question: A financial research firm runs high-performance computing (HPC) simulation jobs on a cluster of Linux EC2 instances. The simulation jobs require a POSIX-compliant distributed file system capable of delivering hundreds of gigabytes per second of throughput and sub-millisecond latencies. The dataset is currently stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution provides the highest performance access to the S3 dataset?
options: Deploy Amazon FSx for Lustre linked directly to the Amazon S3 bucket.
Mount an Amazon EFS file system configured with Bursting Throughput mode to all EC2 instances.
Attach an Amazon EBS gp3 volume with Multi-Attach enabled across all cluster EC2 instances.
Configure AWS Storage Gateway File Gateway to cache S3 objects locally on EC2 instance stores.

question: A mobile application relies on Amazon DynamoDB to serve real-time user profiles and gaming leaderboards. During peak traffic hours, hot key partition queries experience read latency spikes up to 50 milliseconds. The engineering team requires an in-memory caching solution that delivers microsecond response times for read queries without requiring complex application code rewrite or manual cache invalidation logic. Which solution should be implemented?
options: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster and write custom cache-aside logic in the application.
Enable Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) and update the DynamoDB client SDK endpoint in the application.
Migrate the DynamoDB table to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Global Database with Read Replicas.
Increase the provisioned Read Capacity Units (RCUs) on the DynamoDB table by 500%.

question: An IoT platform ingests real-time telemetry data from 50,000 smart building sensors publishing 10,000 metrics per second. The ingestion pipeline uses Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. During peak morning hours, sensor data streams suffer from throttling errors (ProvisionedThroughputExceededException). Additionally, multiple downstream analytics applications (Real-time Alerting, Data Warehouse Loading, and Machine Learning) must process the stream concurrently without impacting each other's processing latency. Which combination of actions resolves the scaling and latency bottlenecks? (Select TWO.)
options: Increase the number of shards in the Kinesis Data Stream or enable Kinesis On-Demand capacity mode.
Configure the Kinesis consumers to use Enhanced Fan-Out with dedicated HTTP/2 throughput pipes.
Migrate Kinesis Data Streams to an Amazon SQS Standard queue with maximum visibility timeout.
Replace Kinesis Data Streams with an AWS Glue ETL batch job scheduled to run every 15 minutes.
Configure an Application Load Balancer to distribute telemetry packets across Kinesis consumer instances.

question: A web application hosted on an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances uses an Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) file system to share dynamic assets across instances. The workload undergoes short, intense bursts of high read/write I/O activity followed by extended periods of low inactivity. During activity bursts, application response times slow significantly because the EFS file system exhausts its accumulated Burst Credits. Which EFS throughput configuration resolves this performance degradation MOST cost-effectively?
options: Configure the Amazon EFS file system to use Elastic Throughput mode.
Configure the Amazon EFS file system to use Provisioned Throughput mode set to 10 GiB/s constantly.
Migrate the shared assets from Amazon EFS to an Amazon S3 Standard bucket and use S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
Attach an Amazon EBS gp3 volume to one EC2 instance and share it via NFS across all instances.

question: An e-commerce company manages a catalog of 10 million products stored in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Users require advanced full-text fuzzy search capabilities, faceted filtering by category, and autocomplete search suggestions on the product website. DynamoDB native query operations cannot fulfill these complex search requirements efficiently. Which architecture provides high-performing search capabilities with real-time data synchronization?
options: Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams, and invoke an AWS Lambda function to index table updates asynchronously into an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster.
Configure an AWS Glue crawler to run every 5 minutes to extract DynamoDB data into an Amazon Athena data lake.
Migrate the product catalog from DynamoDB to an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster with AOF persistence.
Export DynamoDB data daily to Amazon S3, and query the dataset using Amazon Redshift Spectrum.

question:
A serverless REST API built using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda experiences execution delays during daily traffic bursts. Analysis indicates two distinct bottlenecks:
1. Lambda function cold-start initialization delays when scaling up instances.
2. Relational database connection pool exhaustion on the backend Amazon RDS for MySQL database caused by thousands of concurrent Lambda executions creating individual connections.

Which combination of architectural updates resolves both latency bottlenecks?
options: Increase the AWS Lambda memory allocation to 10,240 MB, and configure RDS Read Replicas in multiple Availability Zones.
Configure AWS Lambda Provisioned Concurrency for the function, and deploy an Amazon RDS Proxy between Lambda and the RDS database.
Migrate the REST API from Amazon API Gateway to an Application Load Balancer, and convert the RDS database to Single-AZ.
Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache cluster in front of API Gateway, and enable HTTP keep-alive header modifications.

question: A microservices application runs containerized workloads on Amazon ECS powered by AWS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The operational team needs to implement task scaling that adjusts container task counts dynamically based on incoming traffic load, and collect granular container memory and CPU utilization metrics across tasks. Which combination of components should be configured? (Select TWO.)
options: Enable Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights on the Amazon ECS cluster to collect granular container metrics.
Configure ECS Service Auto Scaling with a Target Tracking policy based on the predefined ALBRequestCountPerTarget metric.
Set up a Step Scaling policy triggered by an EC2 CPUReservation CloudWatch alarm.
Configure AWS App Mesh to automatically deploy new Fargate tasks via sidecar proxies.
Deploy an AWS Systems Manager Agent inside the Fargate task definition container image.

question: A financial company is migrating a legacy enterprise file application to AWS. The application requires concurrent multi-protocol file access (both NFSv3/NFSv4 and SMB protocols) to the same shared file system, sub-millisecond latencies, and enterprise data management features such as block-level deduplication, compression, and thin provisioning. Which storage solution fulfills all these requirements?
options: Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) Provisioned Throughput
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval

question: A company is building a serverless API in multiple AWS Regions. API processing must remain available during a regional disruption, popular GET responses must be cached at edge locations, and database writes must continue in multiple Regions without requiring database failover. Which THREE components meet these requirements? (Select THREE.)
options: Place a CloudFront distribution in front of the API endpoints and configure caching for suitable GET responses.
Deploy Regional API Gateway APIs with Lambda integrations in multiple Regions.
Use DynamoDB Global Tables for active-active multi-Region database reads and writes.
Use one API Gateway edge-optimised endpoint and one Lambda deployment in a single Region.
Use an Aurora Global Database with one writer Region and read-only secondary Regions.
Use Route 53 latency-based routing directly to the Regional API Gateway endpoints without CloudFront.

question:
An e-commerce company operates an application on AWS with three distinct workload profiles:
1. Core API services running on AWS Fargate that maintain a predictable, steady-state baseline usage 24/7.
2. An Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database that experiences low baseline traffic at night but sharp, unpredictable scaling spikes during daily flash sales.
3. Independent, fault-tolerant asynchronous image processing tasks running on containerized workers that can tolerate task interruptions and retries.

A solutions architect needs to reduce infrastructure costs across all three workloads without compromising core application availability or performance. Which combination of actions will deliver the MOST cost-effective architecture? (Select THREE.)
options: Purchase Compute Savings Plans to cover the predictable baseline Fargate compute usage.
Migrate the Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database to Aurora Serverless v2 to scale database capacity dynamically between an appropriate minimum and maximum ACU range based on real-time demand.
Deploy the fault-tolerant asynchronous image processing container workers on AWS Fargate Spot.
Purchase EC2 Instance Savings Plans specifically applied to AWS Fargate tasks across all regions.
Configure the Aurora PostgreSQL database auto-scaling to set minimum capacity to 0 ACUs so it automatically pauses during night hours.
Migrate the core API services to single-AZ EC2 Spot Instances managed by an Auto Scaling group.

question: A company stores millions of data files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Access patterns for these files are unpredictable; some files are accessed frequently during the first week after creation and then never accessed again, while others are accessed randomly months later. A solutions architect needs to optimize S3 storage costs automatically without operational overhead or retrieval performance penalties when accessing data. Which S3 storage class should be selected?
options: Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering
Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval
Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

question: A data analytics application runs on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances spread across two Availability Zones (us-east-1a and us-east-1b). The application instances transfer hundreds of terabytes of data daily between nodes using public IP addresses. Cost Explorer analysis reveals high data transfer charges listed under 'Inter-Region / Inter-AZ Data Transfer'. Which architectural change will REDUCE data transfer costs MOST effectively?
options: Reconfigure the application nodes to communicate with each other using their private IPv4 addresses within the same Availability Zone where possible.
Assign Elastic IP addresses (EIPs) to all EC2 instances and route traffic via an Internet Gateway.
Deploy a CloudFront distribution between the EC2 instances in the two Availability Zones.
Set up an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between us-east-1a and us-east-1b.

question: An enterprise company operates 200 Amazon EC2 instances attached to legacy General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volumes. Cost management audits indicate that many volumes are over-provisioned in storage capacity simply to achieve higher IOPS performance baseline targets. A solutions architect must implement a solution that optimizes storage costs while upgrading disk performance capabilities without requiring downtime or volume recreation. Which action fulfills this requirement?
options: Migrate the EBS volumes from gp2 to General Purpose SSD (gp3) using Elastic Volumes, and provision required IOPS and throughput independently.
Detach the gp2 volumes, attach Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volumes, and restore data from snapshots.
Create an AWS DataSync task to copy data continuously from gp2 volumes to an Amazon S3 Standard bucket.
Convert all gp2 volumes to Throughput Optimized HDD (st1) volumes using the AWS Management Console.

question:
A mobile application utilizes Amazon DynamoDB for user session management and order tracking. The company has two distinct traffic patterns:
1. User sessions: Highly predictable, constant traffic 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
2. Product promotions: Sudden, unannounced spikes exceeding 10x normal traffic for 30 minutes, followed by complete inactivity.

Which combination of DynamoDB capacity modes minimizes costs across both workloads? (Select TWO.)
options: Use Provisioned Capacity mode with Auto Scaling enabled for the predictable user session table.
Use On-Demand Capacity mode for the unpredictable product promotion table.
Use On-Demand Capacity mode for all tables across the entire company.
Use Provisioned Capacity mode with fixed, high static limits for the unpredictable product promotion table.
Purchase Reserved Instances for the product promotion table.

question: A media company runs a batch data analytics pipeline on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. The pipeline processes files stored in Amazon S3, generating 50 TB of data processing monthly. The private subnets route all internet and S3 traffic through NAT Gateways. Cost Explorer shows that NAT Gateway data processing fees account for 60% of the monthly AWS bill. Which architectural change will ELIMINATE these NAT Gateway data processing fees for S3 traffic?
options: Replace the NAT Gateways with NAT Instances running on t4g.nano EC2 instances.
Create a free Gateway VPC Endpoint for Amazon S3 and update the private subnet route tables.
Deploy an AWS Direct Connect location in the private subnet.
Configure an AWS Transit Gateway with cross-region peering to route S3 traffic.

question: A scientific simulation platform runs stateless batch processing jobs on AWS. The jobs can be paused and resumed without losing progress, and processing capacity must scale dynamically up to 500 EC2 instances during execution runs. The company wants to achieve up to 90% cost savings compared to On-Demand pricing while ensuring the Auto Scaling group minimizes Spot Instance reclamation disruptions. Which EC2 Fleet setup fulfills these requirements?
options: Configure an Auto Scaling group using an EC2 Mixed Instances Group with the capacity-optimized allocation strategy across multiple Spot instance pools.
Configure an Auto Scaling group using On-Demand Instances with EC2 Instance Savings Plans.
Deploy a single instance type Auto Scaling group set to lowest-price Spot allocation strategy in a single Availability Zone.
Purchase 500 Convertible Reserved Instances across all regions.

question: An enterprise uses AWS Organizations with 30 member accounts. The central Cloud Financial Management team wants to purchase Compute Savings Plans to lower compute costs across AWS Fargate, AWS Lambda, and Amazon EC2 instances across all accounts. The team needs to ensure that the baseline discounts apply automatically across all accounts in the Organization while maintaining central billing management. Which solution satisfies these billing requirements?
options: Purchase Compute Savings Plans in the Organizations management account or dedicated payer account, and ensure Savings Plan discount sharing is enabled in AWS Billing.
Purchase individual EC2 Instance Savings Plans inside each of the 30 member accounts separately.
Create an AWS CloudFormation StackSet to distribute AWS KMS keys to lock in pricing discounts.
Configure AWS Trusted Advisor to automatically purchase Reserved Instances when usage breaches 80%.

question: An e-commerce company processes customer payment transactions using an asynchronous backend pipeline. Payment messages within each customer session must be processed in order, while unrelated sessions can proceed independently. Duplicate producer submissions within the five-minute deduplication interval are suppressed. Which solution fulfills these requirements?
options: Use an Amazon SQS Standard queue and configure visibility timeout to 300 seconds.
Use an Amazon SQS FIFO queue with a Message Group ID per session and Message Deduplication IDs to suppress repeat submissions during the five-minute deduplication interval.
Use an Amazon SNS Standard topic to publish payment messages to multiple AWS Lambda worker functions.
Deploy an Amazon Kinesis Data Stream with 10 shards and enable server-side encryption.

question: A finance software company wants to mitigate unexpected AWS cost overruns in sandbox accounts. Billing and budget data in AWS Budgets is refreshed periodically (up to three times daily). The team requires an automated cost control mechanism that triggers remediation shortly after a budget data refresh indicates spending has crossed a predefined threshold. Which solution fulfills this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Configure an AWS Budgets alert with an automated notification to an Amazon SNS topic that directly invokes an AWS Lambda function to stop non-compliant EC2 instances after budget data updates.
Create an AWS CloudWatch Alarm on estimated billing metrics to trigger an AWS EventBridge rule every 60 seconds.
Configure an AWS Systems Manager Automation document to poll Cost Explorer hourly via custom Python scripts.
Review monthly AWS Cost Explorer reports manually and email account owners.

question: A security analytics workload runs on EC2 instances in Account B by using an IAM role named AnalyticsRole. Security logs are stored in an S3 bucket in Account A and are encrypted with a customer managed KMS key in Account A. AnalyticsRole already has an identity policy allowing s3:GetObject on the required prefix and kms:Decrypt on the KMS key ARN. However, attempts to read the objects are denied. The company will not use role assumption between the accounts. Which TWO changes provide the required access with least privilege? (Select TWO.)
options: Add an S3 bucket policy in Account A that allows AnalyticsRole to perform s3:GetObject on the required prefix.
Add a KMS key policy in Account A that allows AnalyticsRole to perform kms:Decrypt.
Add an SCP in Account B that allows s3:GetObject and kms:Decrypt.
Add the permissions to an administrative IAM role in Account A.
Add an S3 gateway endpoint policy in Account B that permits access to the bucket.

question: An online retailer publishes order-status changes to billing and fulfilment systems. Both systems must receive every status change independently. Updates for the same customer must remain in order. If the producer retries a request during the messaging deduplication window, the retry must not introduce a duplicate message. The company does not want to maintain custom fan-out or duplicate-suppression infrastructure. Which architecture meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Publish events to an EventBridge event bus that targets two SQS standard queues.

Publish events to an SNS FIFO topic subscribed to two SQS FIFO queues. Use the customer ID as the message group ID and use the same stable order event ID as the deduplication ID for every retry of that event.
Send events to one SQS FIFO queue that is polled by both billing and fulfilment workers.
Write events to a Kinesis data stream with separate billing and fulfilment consumers.

question: A research company stores 100 TB of genomic data in Amazon S3. Each week, hundreds of EC2 instances process the data concurrently by using existing Linux applications that expect a shared file-system interface. The workload requires high-throughput parallel access. S3 must remain the long-term data repository, and processing results must be exported back to S3 after each run. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Create an Amazon EFS file system and copy the complete S3 dataset to EFS before every processing run.
Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system with an S3 data repository association. Return results to S3 by using automatic export or an export data repository task.
Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system and configure SnapMirror replication to S3.
Mount the S3 bucket directly on every EC2 instance by using Mountpoint for Amazon S3.

question: A platform team allows developers to create IAM roles for application workloads. Developers may attach approved policies, but they must never create a role with permissions beyond a security-approved maximum. Which solution is the MOST secure with the LEAST ongoing administration?
options: Require every developer-created role to use a specified permissions boundary and restrict role creation unless that boundary is attached.
Use IAM Access Analyzer to remove excessive permissions after deployment.
Apply an SCP that grants only the permissions developers may place in roles.
Store approved policies in AWS Resource Access Manager and share them with developer accounts.

question: An organization has production and development OUs. Member-account administrators must be prevented from disabling CloudTrail, leaving the organization, or creating resources outside approved Regions. Workloads still need normal IAM permissions inside the approved boundaries. Which solution meets these requirements?
options: Attach an SCP to the relevant OUs that denies the prohibited actions and unapproved Regions while exempting required global services.
Create permission boundaries for every IAM principal in every account.
Configure AWS Config rules that remediate prohibited actions after they occur.
Use resource-based policies on CloudTrail and regional services.

question: A company must encrypt application secrets and rotate database credentials automatically. Applications run on ECS tasks and must retrieve the current value without storing long-term credentials in task definitions. Which solution has the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Store the credentials in Secrets Manager, enable managed rotation for the database, and grant the ECS task role permission to retrieve the secret.
Store the credentials in an encrypted S3 object and rotate the object with a scheduled EC2 script.
Store the credentials in Parameter Store Standard parameters and manually update them monthly.
Place the credentials in ECS environment variables encrypted by the container image build system.

question: A company exposes a public application through an Application Load Balancer. It needs protection against common web exploits, automated request floods from individual IP addresses, and common infrastructure-layer DDoS attacks. Which THREE services or features should the company use? (Select THREE.)
options: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL containing managed rule groups with the ALB.
Add an AWS WAF rate-based rule to the web ACL.
Use AWS Shield Standard protections that are automatically available for supported resources.
Enable GuardDuty to block malicious HTTP requests at the ALB.
Use a Network ACL to inspect SQL injection payloads.
Place the ALB behind a gateway VPC endpoint.

question: EC2 instances in private subnets must call a third-party SaaS service hosted behind an AWS endpoint service. The connection must stay on private IP addresses, tolerate overlapping CIDR ranges, and prevent the SaaS provider from initiating connections into the customer VPC. Which solution meets the requirements?
options: Create a VPC peering connection to the provider VPC.
Create an interface VPC endpoint powered by AWS PrivateLink.
Attach both VPCs to the same transit gateway.
Create a Site-to-Site VPN between the VPCs.

question: A central security account must collect findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, and AWS Config across all organization accounts and Regions. Security analysts need one standards dashboard and centralized prioritization. Which solution meets the requirements with the LEAST operational effort?
options: Configure Security Hub with organization integration, delegated administration, and cross-Region aggregation.
Send every service log to one CloudWatch Logs group using subscription filters.
Create an organization CloudTrail and query all events with Athena.
Use Systems Manager OpsCenter as the only finding aggregator.

question: A mobile application needs user sign-up, social sign-in, and temporary scoped AWS credentials so authenticated users can upload files directly to S3. Which design meets these requirements?
options: Use a Cognito user pool for authentication and a Cognito identity pool to exchange tokens for temporary IAM credentials.
Use IAM Identity Center and create one IAM user for each mobile customer.
Use only a Cognito user pool and attach an S3 bucket policy directly to each user.
Use only a Cognito identity pool with long-term IAM access keys embedded in the application.

question: A company stores regulated records in S3. Records must use a specific customer managed KMS key, remain immutable for seven years, and reject uploads that omit the required encryption headers. Which THREE controls meet these requirements? (Select THREE.)
options: Enable S3 Versioning on the bucket.
Enable S3 Object Lock and set default retention in Compliance mode for seven years.
Add bucket-policy Deny statements that reject PutObject requests unless SSE-KMS and the approved key are specified.
Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration to protect uploads in transit.
Use an S3 lifecycle rule to delete noncurrent versions after 30 days.
Use a KMS AWS managed key so users cannot change the key policy.

question: An S3 bucket should allow one partner role in an approved external account and all principals from the company AWS organization, but no other accounts. Which resource-policy design is MOST secure?
options: Use separate Allow statements for the partner role and principals whose aws:PrincipalOrgID matches the organization ID, with no public principal.
Allow Principal * and rely only on an aws:SourceVpc condition.
List every current organization account root ARN and update the policy manually.
Use an SCP in the management account to grant the partner role access.

question: Administrators need shell access to private EC2 instances without public IP addresses, inbound SSH rules, or stored SSH keys. Session commands must be logged centrally. Which solution has the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Use Systems Manager Session Manager and send session logs to CloudWatch Logs or S3.
Deploy a bastion host in every Availability Zone.
Open SSH only from the corporate public IP range.
Create a Client VPN and continue using shared SSH keys.

question: An AWS Organizations organization requires central logging of management API activity from all current and future member accounts. Member-account administrators must not be able to disable or modify the central trail. After delivery, the log objects must be protected from deletion or overwrite for the required retention period. Which TWO actions meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)
options: Create an organization trail from the management account or a CloudTrail delegated administrator and deliver the logs to a central S3 bucket.
Enable S3 Object Lock in Compliance mode on the central log bucket and configure an appropriate retention period.
Enable CloudTrail log file validation to detect whether delivered log files were modified or deleted.
Create separate trails in every member account and allow each account administrator to manage the local trail.
Send CloudTrail events only to CloudWatch Logs in the management account and configure metric filters.

question: A workload in private subnets must access Secrets Manager without NAT gateways or public IP addresses. The security team must restrict endpoint use to specific secrets and an application role. Which design meets the requirements?
options: Create a Secrets Manager interface VPC endpoint, enable private DNS, and apply a restrictive endpoint policy.
Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Secrets Manager.
Use an internet gateway with a security group that allows only AWS IP ranges.
Create an S3 gateway endpoint and store the secrets in S3.

question: A security team wants early detection and centralized remediation of public S3 buckets and security groups that allow unrestricted administrative ports across 40 accounts. Which TWO services should be configured? (Select TWO.)
options: Use AWS Config organization rules to evaluate configurations and invoke Systems Manager Automation remediation.
Use Security Hub with organization integration to aggregate compliance findings and standards results.
Use GuardDuty to change noncompliant security-group rules automatically.
Use CloudTrail Lake as the only configuration-compliance engine.
Use Shield Advanced to identify public buckets.

question: A company must allow an application role in Account A to publish only to one SNS topic in Account B. Which approach provides the LEAST privilege?
options: Add sns:Publish for the topic ARN to the role policy and add a topic policy that permits the external role.
Create an IAM user in Account B and store its access keys in the application.
Allow sns:* on all resources in both accounts.
Use an SCP in Account B to grant the role permission to publish.

question: A company runs stateless web servers in two Availability Zones. Traffic changes unpredictably, and an instance or Availability Zone failure must not interrupt service. Which TWO design choices meet the requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Select TWO.)
options: Place the instances in an Auto Scaling group spanning both Availability Zones and use target tracking scaling.
Place an Application Load Balancer in both Availability Zones and use load balancer health checks for the Auto Scaling group.
Run fixed instances in both Availability Zones and replace failed instances manually.
Use one large instance in each Availability Zone with DNS round robin.
Place all instances in one Availability Zone and copy AMIs to another Region.

question: A CloudFront distribution serves static content from an S3 bucket in one Region. The company maintains a synchronized backup bucket in another Region. For GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS requests, CloudFront must automatically use the backup when the primary origin times out or returns selected server errors. Which solution meets the requirements?
options: Create a CloudFront origin group with the primary and secondary S3 origins and configure failover status codes.
Use Route 53 failover records for the CloudFront distribution domain.
Place the S3 buckets behind Global Accelerator.
Use Lambda@Edge to modify DNS records after every 5xx response.

question: A global application uses Application Load Balancers in two Regions. Users should normally use the Region with the lowest network latency. If one ALB has no healthy targets, DNS must stop returning it. Which solution meets the requirements with the LEAST operational effort?
options: Create Route 53 latency alias records for both ALBs and enable Evaluate Target Health.
Create primary and secondary Route 53 failover records.
Create equal-weight Route 53 weighted records with no health evaluation.
Use geolocation records based only on user country.

question: A payment workflow uses Step Functions Standard Workflows. A Lambda task can fail with transient service errors, but validation errors should go directly to manual review. The workflow must retry transient failures with increasing delays and capture exhausted failures without losing the original input. Which TWO state-machine features meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)
options: Configure a Retry block for transient error names with IntervalSeconds, BackoffRate, and MaxAttempts.
Configure a Catch block after the retriers that routes failures to review and uses ResultPath to preserve the original input.
Increase the Lambda timeout and retry every error indefinitely.
Use a Choice state before the task to predict whether Lambda will fail.
Convert the workflow to an Express Workflow because Express guarantees task success.

question: An order service sends work to an SQS standard queue. A worker may crash after receiving a message but before deleting it. Processing is idempotent, and failed messages must not block new work indefinitely. Which design is MOST resilient?
options: Set an appropriate visibility timeout, make processing idempotent, and configure a dead-letter queue with a maxReceiveCount.
Set the visibility timeout to zero so another worker immediately receives every message.
Use a short retention period and discard messages after the first failure.
Replace the queue with direct synchronous calls between services.

question: A company runs Aurora PostgreSQL in one Region and needs a secondary Region for disaster recovery. The target RPO is measured in seconds and recovery time is measured in minutes, but zero data loss is not required. Which solution has the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Create an Aurora Global Database with a secondary cluster and use managed cross-Region failover when required.
Copy snapshots to the second Region once per day.
Use synchronous application writes to independent Aurora clusters in both Regions.
Create a Multi-AZ Aurora cluster only in the primary Region.

question: A company is designing disaster recovery in a second AWS Region. Only critical core services, such as data replication and essential supporting components, will run continuously. During recovery, the operations team will launch and scale the application servers before redirecting production traffic, and the business accepts this additional recovery step to reduce steady-state cost. Which disaster recovery strategy meets these requirements?
options: Pilot light
Backup and restore
Warm standby
Multi-site active-active

question: A company runs critical EC2 workloads and RDS databases in one Region. It requires centrally managed backups, cross-account isolation from production administrators, and copies in a second Region. The solution will use cross-account and cross-Region AWS Backup copy operations only for resource types and Regions that support those operations. Which THREE actions meet the requirements? (Select THREE.)
options: Use AWS Backup policies to protect the required resources across organization accounts.
Copy recovery points to a backup vault in a dedicated backup account.
Configure cross-Region copy to a vault in the recovery Region.
Store all backups in the production account and grant administrators full vault access.
Use EC2 instance-store snapshots as the database backup mechanism.
Rely only on Multi-AZ deployments as backups.

question: A web application stores user session data on individual EC2 instance volumes. Users lose sessions when Auto Scaling replaces an instance. Which change makes the application more resilient?
options: Move session state to a shared managed store such as ElastiCache for Redis or DynamoDB.
Enable termination protection on every Auto Scaling instance.
Use larger instance-store volumes.
Configure ALB stickiness as the only session protection.

question: A company must process independent image jobs from an SQS queue. One malformed image can repeatedly crash a worker and delay other jobs. The company wants fault isolation with the LEAST application change. Which solution meets the requirements?
options: Configure a dead-letter queue and redrive policy, and process each message independently with an appropriate visibility timeout.
Increase queue retention and remove the visibility timeout.
Place all image jobs in one FIFO message group.
Use one long-running worker and stop receiving messages after the first error.

question: An application publishes business events to EventBridge. A faulty deployment processes events incorrectly for two hours. After the defect is fixed, the company must resend only the affected historical events to the same event bus without maintaining a custom event store. Which feature meets the requirement?
options: EventBridge archive and replay
EventBridge schema registry
EventBridge API destinations
CloudWatch Logs metric filters

question: A company has a primary application stack in one Region and a fully functional but scaled-down stack in another Region. The secondary continuously receives database updates and can scale to production capacity after traffic is switched. Which disaster recovery strategy is described?
options: Warm standby
Pilot light
Backup and restore
Multi-site active-active

question: A database workload on EC2 requires consistently high IOPS, low latency, and independent provisioning of storage capacity and IOPS beyond gp3 limits. Which EBS volume type best meets the requirement?
options: Provisioned IOPS SSD io2
General Purpose SSD gp3
Throughput Optimized HDD st1
Cold HDD sc1

question: A Windows application uses SMB shares, Microsoft Active Directory integration, Windows ACLs, and Distributed File System features. It must run across multiple Availability Zones with managed failover. Which storage service meets the requirements?
options: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server with Multi-AZ deployment
Amazon EFS Regional
Amazon FSx for Lustre persistent deployment
S3 with Mountpoint for Amazon S3

question: A Linux application runs on EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. All instances need concurrent access to the same elastic POSIX file system. Capacity should grow and shrink automatically. Which solution meets the requirements?
options: Use a Regional EFS file system with mount targets in the required Availability Zones.
Attach one gp3 EBS volume to all instances across Availability Zones.
Use S3 as a fully POSIX-compliant shared block device.
Create one instance-store RAID array and share it by NFS.

question: A multiplayer game exposes TCP and UDP services from two AWS Regions. Players require static anycast IP addresses, routing over the AWS global network, and rapid health-based rerouting that is not dependent on DNS cache expiration. Which TWO components should be used? (Select TWO.)
options: Create a standard AWS Global Accelerator with endpoint groups in both Regions.
Register Regional Network Load Balancers or EC2 instances as accelerator endpoints.
Configure Route 53 latency-based records for Regional Network Load Balancers with a TTL of 60 seconds.
Assign Elastic IP addresses to Network Load Balancers in each Region and publish all addresses to game clients.
Deploy CloudFront in front of Regional Application Load Balancers and enable origin failover.

question: A read-heavy DynamoDB application needs microsecond response times. The application can be changed to use a cache-aware client, and eventual consistency is acceptable for cached reads. Which solution has the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX).
Use ElastiCache for Redis as a manually maintained write-through cache.
Add an RDS read replica.
Place CloudFront in front of the DynamoDB endpoint.

question: A relational database is overloaded by repeated reads of product and session data. The cache must support replicas, automatic failover, persistence options, and rich data structures. Which service best meets the requirements?
options: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey or Redis OSS with replication enabled
Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached
DynamoDB Accelerator
Amazon OpenSearch Service

question: A public HTTP API needs path-based routing to multiple services and TLS termination at the load balancer. Which load balancer type meets the requirements?
options: Application Load Balancer
Network Load Balancer
Gateway Load Balancer
Classic Load Balancer

question: A company processes a continuous stream of click events. Multiple independent consumers need the same ordered records, and one consumer may replay older records within the retention period. Throughput must scale by partitioning. Which service meets the requirements?
options: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
Amazon SQS standard queue
Amazon SNS standard topic without durable subscriptions
Amazon EventBridge Scheduler

question: A container platform runs latency-sensitive services on ECS. The company needs control over EC2 instance types for specialized networking and wants both task scaling and cluster-capacity scaling. Which TWO configurations meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)
options: Run the ECS service on an EC2 capacity provider backed by an Auto Scaling group containing the required instance types.
Configure ECS service auto scaling for task count and capacity provider managed scaling for the Auto Scaling group.
Use Fargate only because Fargate lets the company select every underlying EC2 instance type.
Scale only the ALB desired capacity and keep a fixed number of tasks.
Use EKS Cluster Autoscaler to manage the ECS cluster.

question: A Lambda-backed API experiences database connection exhaustion during traffic spikes. The relational database supports connection pooling, and the company wants the LEAST application and operational change. Which solution meets the requirement?
options: Place Amazon RDS Proxy between Lambda and the database.
Increase Lambda reserved concurrency without changing connections.
Create a NAT gateway in each Availability Zone.
Store each database connection in DynamoDB.

question: A company needs a load balancer for millions of TCP connections with very low latency and a static IP address in each enabled Availability Zone. Which solution meets the requirements?
options: Network Load Balancer
Application Load Balancer
Gateway Load Balancer
Route 53 weighted routing

question: A REST API receives large numbers of repeated identical GET requests. Each request currently invokes backend Lambda functions, EC2 services, or database queries, increasing backend execution and processing costs. Responses can be cached for several minutes. The company wants to reduce backend cost without changing backend code. Which solution meets the requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
options: Enable API Gateway stage caching for the applicable methods.
Add a larger Auto Scaling group behind the API.
Store responses on EBS volumes attached to Lambda.
Use Route 53 weighted records to split identical requests.

question: A company runs a predictable baseline of EC2, Fargate, and Lambda compute continuously. Instance families and Regions may change over time. Which pricing option provides the broadest commitment discount with the LEAST restriction?
options: Compute Savings Plans
EC2 Instance Savings Plans
Standard Reserved Instances for one instance family
Spot Instances for the baseline

question: A media company runs always-on ECS services and interruptible overnight container batch jobs. The company wants the MOST cost-effective design without risking interruption of the baseline services. Which TWO strategies should it use? (Select TWO.)
options: Purchase Compute Savings Plans for the predictable baseline container usage.
Run fault-tolerant batch tasks on Fargate Spot.
Run all baseline services on Fargate Spot.
Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for ECS tasks.
Use Dedicated Hosts for all container workloads.

question: A company stores logs that are frequently read for 30 days, rarely read for the next 60 days, and retained for seven years with retrieval times up to 12 hours. Which lifecycle design is MOST cost-effective?
options: Keep data in S3 Standard, transition to S3 Standard-IA after 30 days, then to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 90 days.
Move data directly to S3 Glacier Deep Archive on creation.
Keep all data in S3 Standard for seven years.
Transition to S3 One Zone-IA after 30 days and delete it after 90 days.

question: Private-subnet applications send large amounts of traffic to S3 and DynamoDB through NAT gateways in each Availability Zone. They still need occasional IPv4 internet access for software repositories. Which TWO changes reduce cost without reducing Availability Zone resilience? (Select TWO.)
options: Add an S3 gateway endpoint and associate it with the private route tables.
Add a DynamoDB gateway endpoint and associate it with the private route tables.
Replace all NAT gateways with one NAT gateway in one Availability Zone.
